skill.name: persona-project-manager
skill.description: Coordinate project status, meetings, files, and stakeholder updates across Google Workspace with the gws CLI.
skill.summary: Run practical Google Workspace workflows for project coordination.
skill.author: googleworkspace

security_audit.summary: All 12 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline-code backticks, not Ruby or shell command substitution. The skill still directs authenticated Google Workspace writes without explicit approval requirements, creating operational risk despite its dry-run guidance.

remediation.issue: Write operations can affect shared Workspace resources without explicit user approval.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before uploads, appends, invitations, announcements, or email sends. Show targets and use dry-run where supported.

content.value_statement: Project coordination spreads updates across calendars, inboxes, files, and trackers. This skill organizes common Google Workspace workflows through the gws command-line tool.
actual_capabilities: Generate weekly digests of upcoming meetings and unread items.
Append project status updates to Google Sheets.
Upload project artifacts to Drive and announce shared files.
Create recurring standup meetings with team attendees.
Send project status emails to stakeholders.
Find project folders in Drive and filter triage output.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and five listed Google Workspace utility skills.
Depends on the user's Google Workspace permissions and authenticated account.
Does not define approval rules, recipient validation, or organization-specific governance.
Supports Google Workspace workflows only and does not replace a dedicated project tracker.

use_cases.title: Prepare a weekly project review
use_cases.description: Collect upcoming meetings and unread items, then organize a concise weekly coordination summary.

use_cases.title: Maintain a shared status tracker
use_cases.description: Append structured progress updates to a Google Sheet for consistent team visibility.

use_cases.title: Distribute project artifacts
use_cases.description: Upload deliverables to Drive and announce their availability through approved communication channels.

prompt_templates.title: Create a weekly digest
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a weekly digest of my upcoming project meetings and unread project items. Do not make any changes.

prompt_templates.title: Update the project tracker
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a status update for the project sheet using these notes: [notes]. Show the proposed row before appending it.

prompt_templates.title: Schedule recurring standups
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a recurring standup for [team] during [date range]. Propose times and attendees, then wait for approval before creating events.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a project release
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare the release artifact upload, stakeholder email, and team announcement for [project]. Preview every target and action before execution.

output_examples.input: Summarize this week's project schedule and unread updates.
output: Three project meetings are scheduled this week.
Two unread stakeholder updates need review.

output_examples.input: Draft a status tracker entry from the latest team notes.
output_examples.output: Proposed tracker entry: Integration testing is active, documentation review is pending, and the target completion date is Friday. Awaiting approval to append.

output_examples.input: Prepare a recurring standup for the launch team.
output_examples.output: Proposed schedule: Tuesday and Thursday at 10:00. Attendee list and recurrence details are ready for confirmation before calendar creation.

best_practices: Use dry-run or preview modes before every supported write operation.
Confirm recipients, attendees, file destinations, and sheet ranges before execution.
Use the least privileged Google Workspace account that can complete the task.
anti_patterns: Do not send messages or invitations without explicit user approval.
Do not upload sensitive files to unverified Drive folders.
Do not append updates before validating the destination sheet and row content.

faq.question: What tools does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires the gws CLI plus Drive, Sheets, Calendar, Gmail, and Chat utility skills.

faq.question: Can it create calendar events?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prepare recurring standups and create them after the user confirms timing and attendees.

faq.question: Can it update project trackers?
faq.answer: Yes. It can append status information to Google Sheets when the account has suitable permissions.

faq.question: Does it support read-only planning?
faq.answer: Yes. Weekly digests and Drive searches can support planning without changing workspace data.

faq.question: Can it send stakeholder communications?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prepare Gmail updates and file announcements, but users should approve recipients and content first.

faq.question: Does it replace project management software?
faq.answer: No. It coordinates Google Workspace activities but does not provide dependencies, resource planning, or full portfolio reporting.
